body: Tested this PR. Selecting multiple nodes and pressing `Ctrl + A` brings up the Create Node window and creates the selected node as children to the selected nodes. One inconsistency is that the "Add Child Node…" option doesn't appear in the context menu for multi-selected nodes: … whereas it does show up in the single selection context menu:
LGTM. Didn't look at the code.

Tested locally, it works as expected (including undo/redo). Code looks good to me.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7e46a175-a60c-4f78-a255-8c47a23ca4b5

However, I get a consistently reproducible crash when adding a new node when there is no node currently selected in the scene tree dock (not even the root node):
